name: key_missing
violation_expr: time IS NULL OR trim(time) = '' OR grid_latitude IS NULL OR grid_longitude IS NULL

name: ts_unparseable
violation_expr: time IS NOT NULL AND trim(time) <> '' AND time_utc IS NULL
description: time does not match yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm on the hour

name: ts_outside_request
description: hour outside the requested period 2012-10-01 00:00:00 .. 2018-10-01 23:00:00 UTC

name: missing_variable
violation_expr: temperature_2m IS NULL OR precipitation IS NULL OR rain IS NULL OR snowfall IS NULL OR cloud_cover IS NULL OR weather_code IS NULL OR wind_speed_10m IS NULL
description: one of the requested hourly variables is NULL

name: type_non_finite
violation_expr: isnan(CAST(temperature_2m AS DOUBLE)) OR isnan(CAST(precipitation AS DOUBLE)) OR isnan(CAST(rain AS DOUBLE)) OR isnan(CAST(snowfall AS DOUBLE)) OR isnan(CAST(cloud_cover AS DOUBLE)) OR isnan(CAST(weather_code AS DOUBLE)) OR isnan(CAST(wind_speed_10m AS DOUBLE))

name: type_integer_codes
description: weather_code or cloud_cover is not an integer

name: range_precipitation
violation_expr: precipitation < 0 OR precipitation > 305.0 OR rain < 0 OR rain > 305.0

name: range_weather_code_unknown
description: weather_code is not one of the documented WMO codes

name: range_rain_above_precipitation
description: rain exceeds total precipitation (rain is part of precipitation)

name: unique_key_conflicting
description: several rows for one (grid point, hour) disagree; values set to NULL

name: unique_key_duplicate
description: identical rows for one (grid point, hour); collapsed to one
